readerCopy.body: One conversation, message, application, introduction, or useful detail can clarify the next step with surprising efficiency. When Mercury trines the North Node, communication and forward movement reinforce each other, making the information most relevant to a pending decision easier to notice and use. A small fact can save a large amount of speculation. The direction becomes clearer when the missing information arrives at the moment it can actually change a choice.
